verdict.rationale: The open-source CLI on GitHub runs locally and can pull skills from sources you control: private repos using your existing auth, GitLab, Azure DevOps Server, or direct archive URLs. That lets a team run a skills workflow without depending on Vercel's hosted service. However, nothing shows the skills.sh directory or leaderboard itself can be self-hosted. missing for 10: self-hostable skills.sh registry/leaderboard, documented self-hosting or deployment guide, independent corroboration of fully offline/self-hosted use.
